registered_before: any P5-N2 simulation is scored or any P5-N2 discharge current / thrust prediction is inspected. Known: the measurement audit (PR #26) and the blind state envelope (chemistry-state quantities only, measured targets removed).
decided_by: project owner: decisions D1-D6 and operational rules O1-O5 (O2, O3, O5 confirmed as proposed with the owner's additions; O1 and O4 amended by the owner), 2026-09-26
purpose: no-retuning discrimination of the 9 ScaledGaussianBohm screening candidates on P5-N2 (promotion rule, CLAUDE.md next work 1)
no_retuning: transport parameters, chemistry, numerics (200 cells, dt 5 ns, 2 ms, average 1-2 ms), wall model and B-field hypotheses are fixed for every run; no parameter is adjusted per case, per point or after results are seen

D1_observables.non_gating_diagnostic: E x B species acceleration voltages V_a,N2+ and V_a,N+ at N1-N3: signed residuals and species ordering are recorded; never used to admit or reject (the 1 m far-field observation operator is not modelled)

D2_thrust_N4_N5: not scored; measured values reported as unscored supporting evidence; no divergence factor is invented or extrapolated

D3_tolerances.discharge_current: |I_d,sim - I_d,exp| / I_d,exp <= 0.15 at each point (the P5-Xe blind scale; not tightened)
D3_tolerances.thrust_definition: |T_axial,sim - T_obs| <= tolerance, T_axial,sim = T_1D x f_reading, f from the audit (reading A: sqrt(Psi_b as plotted); reading B: consistent with measured thrust)
D3_tolerances.divergence_readings: a discrete layer-1 nuisance (D5), not added to the tolerance

D4_modes.never_crossed: a facility run is never compared with a vacuum-corrected target or vice versa

D5_layer1.members: 3 registrations (L38-hist, L32-anode, L32-exit) x 2 coil shapes (1.6 kW, 3.0 kW scaled to 130 G; field-shape hypotheses) x 2 divergence readings (A, B) = 12 per mode
D5_layer1.global: a layer-1 member is fixed across the whole N1-N5 series; never chosen point by point
D5_layer1.across_chemistry: the same layer-1 member must support the candidate across all four mandatory chemistry configurations
D5_layer1.vacuum_admission: a candidate is PROMOTABLE iff there exists one layer-1 member such that, for every mandatory chemistry configuration and every point, the vacuum run is PASS on every primary criterion

n2_n_n2dication.toml.note: defined only on DI-lower (the DI-upper table already counts N2^2+ as N+); compared against n2_n_di_lower.toml, never n2_n.toml; no DI-upper combinations exist

run_count.mandatory: 9 candidates x 4 chemistry x 30 cases x 2 modes = 2160 runs (1080 vacuum first, then 1080 facility); readings A/B are post-processing
run_count.staged: 9 x 30 x 2 = 540 runs per sensitivity branch when run

O1_extinction_SUSTAINMENT.rule: FAIL_VALIDATION / SUSTAINMENT iff BOTH: (a) the mean I_d over the final 10 % of the simulated time is < 0.05 x I_d,target, AND (b) >= 90 % of the I_d samples in that final 10 % are < 0.10 x I_d,target
O1_extinction_SUSTAINMENT.target: mode-matched: vacuum -> Eq. (14)-corrected I_d; facility -> raw P_d/V_d
O1_extinction_SUSTAINMENT.not_extinction: a low but steady discharge fails CURRENT, not SUSTAINMENT; a single deep breathing trough does not trigger SUSTAINMENT
O1_extinction_SUSTAINMENT.bridge_sustained_flag: the bridge's 'sustained' (window minimum > 1 % of mean, hall_map_schema_v1 bookkeeping) is a diagnostic only and never controls a validation status

O2_precedence.NUMERICAL_FAILURE: solver failure, non-finite state, invalid time history, or inability to produce the required observables; NOT the bridge 'sustained' flag
O2_precedence.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: chemistry domain evaluated directly from the reaction-validity audit: f_out <= 1e-12 for every reaction and no unresolved table, independent of sustainment (the bridge's combined chemistry_trustworthy Boolean is not used alone because it includes 'sustained')
O2_precedence.collapse_outside_domain: a run that collapses AND crosses the chemistry validity boundary is OUT_OF_DOMAIN, not a SUSTAINMENT falsification
O2_precedence.FAIL_VALIDATION: all failing reasons are listed (CURRENT, THRUST, SUSTAINMENT)

O3_verdicts.layer1_member: global member = (registration, coil shape, divergence reading), vacuum, 4 mandatory chemistries x 5 points = 20 runs: PASS iff all 20 PASS; FAIL if any run is FAIL_VALIDATION; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (some OUT_OF_DOMAIN or NUMERICAL_FAILURE, no validation failure)
O3_verdicts.candidate: PROMOTABLE iff some global member PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE / NOT ELIGIBLE if any member INCONCLUSIVE; else FAIL_VALIDATION (a genuine validation failure under every global member)
O3_verdicts.facility: reported with the same aggregation; never gates

O4_staged_escalation.first_run: each staged sensitivity against ITS BASELINE (n2_n.toml for Johnson-low, rotational-off, HMS x0.5, HMS x1.3; n2_n_di_lower.toml for molecular N2^2+), in VACUUM, 9 candidates x 30 cases; deltas are sensitivity minus baseline for the same candidate, case and mode
escalate_to_other_three_primary_combinat: |delta T_axial| >= 0.5 x T_tolerance: N1 2.6 mN, N2 2.8 mN, N3 2.8 mN
replacing nominal chemistry by the sensitivity changes a provisional global-member or candidate verdict
O4_staged_escalation.facility: facility sensitivity results may be produced as secondary evidence; facility-only differences never trigger escalation
O4_staged_escalation.escalation_configs: pre-generated and hash-pinned (staged_sensitivities.*.escalation; scripts/make_n2_variant_configs.py ESCALATION): on escalation each sensitivity is run on every listed primary combination and compared with that combination

O5_ExB_diagnostic.model_observable: V_a,s,model = m_s u_z,s^2 / (2 Z_s e) at the model-domain outlet, for N2+ and N+
reported: the species' outlet ion flux and flux fraction beside each value (no minimum-flux threshold)

execution_order: both modes are pre-registered and both are run. The 1080 mandatory VACUUM runs execute first and the promotion result is evaluated from them; the 1080 facility runs follow as secondary consistency evidence. No criterion changes between the two.
review_fixes_before_merge: PR #27 review (2026-09-26, before merge and before any run): the molecular-N2^2+ branch baseline set to n2_n_di_lower.toml (it differs from n2_n.toml in two changes), and all 13 escalation-combination configs generated and pinned now so that no chemistry is defined after results
